why: The record line 'Brought up, and read the First time.' after a new clause had no kind and so read as the clause's text; it is PROCEDURAL with no speaker, and the mover's words after it keep the mover.
title: LEGAL PROFESSION (AMENDMENT) BILL
html:
Parliament No:9
Session No:2
Volume No:71
Sitting No:7
Sitting Date:17-01-2000
Section Name:BILLS
Title:LEGAL PROFESSION (AMENDMENT) BILL
MPs Speaking:Assoc. Prof. Ho Peng Kee (Minister of State for Law); Assoc. Prof. Chin Tet Yung; Mr J. B. Jeyaretnam; Mr K. Shanmugam; Mr Noris Ong Chin Guan; Mr R. Ravindran; Mr Sin Boon Ann; Mrs Lim Hwee Hua; Mr Eugene Yap Giau Cheng (Mr Deputy Speaker);
The Chairman: The citation year "1999" will be changed to "2000" as indicated in the Order Paper Supplement.

    Clause 1 ordered to stand part of the Bill.

    Clauses 2 to 16 inclusive ordered to stand part of the Bill.

    New Clause -

    "Amendment of section 135

    Section 135 of the principal Act is amended by

    deleting the words "and the payment thereof shall be

    denoted by an impressed stamp on the relevant

    document".".

    Brought up, and read the First time.

Column: 779



    Assoc. Prof. Ho Peng Kee: Sir, I beg to move, "That the clause be read a Second time."

    Sir, this amendment is consequential to the amendment made in clause 3 of the Bill. Clause 3 amends section 25 of the Act to allow practising certificates to be issued electronically.
